tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List the regions secretsanta.name knows: code, local name of the game, language, and currency. Use a code as region on the other tools. CT is Catalonia. Read-only. Reveals no assignments.

tools.name: create_draw
tools.description: Create a draw and run it. Returns the organizer link plus one private link per person who has no email. NEVER returns who gives to whom. People with an email get their link only by email: call send_invites. Couples and households are groups of names who must not draw each other. Exclusions are one-w

tools.name: get_draw
tools.description: Organizer status for one draw: who has opened their private link (pressed the button; a chat preview does not count), who has filled a wish list, and email status. Does not return wish-list text, shipping addresses, or who gives to whom.

tools.name: get_group_share_message
tools.description: Text the organizer can paste in WhatsApp, Telegram, or Slack. The group text has no private links and names nobody's assignment. Also returns one private message per person, which must be sent only to that person. Localized to language/region. Refuses if the draw has not been made.

tools.name: send_invites
tools.description: Email each person who has an address their own private link, using the site's normal mail flow and the same daily cap (EMAIL_DAILY_CAP) and per-network limit as the website. Does not return the links or who gives to whom. Fails clearly when email is off or the draw is not done.

tools.name: resend_invitation
tools.description: Send one person's invitation email again. Rate-limited like the website's email button. If that person has no email, returns only their private share message and not anyone else's. Does not reveal who they give a gift to.

tools.name: add_participant
tools.description: Add one person before anyone has opened their link (pressed reveal). If the draw was already made and nobody has opened it, it is redrawn with the same private links for the people who were already in it. Refuses once anyone has opened their link. Does not reveal assignments. Optional couple is the

tools.name: remove_participant
tools.description: Remove one person before anyone has opened their link. If the draw was already made, it is redrawn, or left unchanged when the smaller group is impossible. Refuses once anyone has opened their link. Does not reveal assignments.

tools.name: redraw
tools.description: Make a new draw with the same people and the same private links, before anyone has opened their link. If the rules are impossible, the previous draw is kept and the reason is returned. allow_reciprocal can be changed in the same call. Refuses once anyone has opened their link. Does not reveal who gi

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Read one participant's own wish list, using their private token (the /s/ link). Does not return who they give a gift to, their Secret Santa's wishes, or anyone else's list. The organizer token cannot read wish lists.

tools.name: add_to_wishlist
tools.description: Append items to one participant's own wish list (name, optional http(s) URL, optional note), up to 10. Uses their private token. replace=true overwrites the list. Does not reveal who they give a gift to. Only their Secret Santa sees the list, on the website, after revealing.

tools.name: gift_ideas
tools.description: Suggest a few gift ideas for a budget, optional interests, and language, plus the site's own shops when one fits. Ideas are suggestions, not a catalog. Read-only. No draw and no personal data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_draw, get_draw, get_group_share_message, add_to_wishlist · Private data: create_draw, get_draw, get_group_share_message, send_invites, resend_invitation, add_participant, redraw, get_wishlist, add_to_wishlist · Public sink: create_draw, get_draw, get_group_share_message, send_invites, resend_invitation · Destructive: create_draw, remove_participant.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_draw, get_draw, get_group_share_message, add_to_wishlist · Private data: create_draw, get_draw, get_group_share_message, send_invites, resend_invitation, add_participant, redraw, get_wishlist, add_to_wishlist · Public sink: create_draw, get_draw, get_group_share_message, send_invites, resend_invitation · Destructive: create_draw, remove_participant

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
